capabilities.adds: Inverse-distance k-nearest-neighbour over unit-scaled inputs; V(0) from the published OCV table and T(0) = ambient
capabilities.attack_surface: Retrieval of training cases at inference; an attacker with access to the kNN index could probe the training distribution
capabilities.bounds: lab_kind battery_knn; selector knn; no architecture subset
capabilities.rationale: Non-parametric baseline for battery trajectory prediction; provides a simple reference model for the fast-charge ageing challenge
capabilities.reconstruction: Rebuild the kNN model with inverse-distance weighting on unit-scaled inputs, using the published OCV table for V(0) and ambient temperature for T(0)

capabilities.adds: GELU MLP on normalized trajectory targets; campaign recipe at defaults (full-batch Adam(W), cosine decay); T(0) = ambient
capabilities.attack_surface: Standard neural network inference path; learned weights could be probed for training data leakage
capabilities.bounds: lab_kind battery_mlp; selector mlp
capabilities.rationale: Standard feed-forward baseline for battery trajectory regression; the campaign's written-out default recipe
capabilities.reconstruction: Rebuild the MLP with GELU activations on normalized trajectory targets, using full-batch Adam(W) with cosine decay at the campaign defaults

capabilities.adds: Battery DeepONet: branch MLP over four inputs and trunk MLP over the 30 s time grid form voltage and temperature trajectories; branch also heads plating margin and capacity
capabilities.attack_surface: Branch and trunk network weights; an attacker could probe the branch for input sensitivities or the trunk for temporal interpolation artifacts
capabilities.bounds: lab_kind battery_deeponet; selector deeponet
capabilities.rationale: Operator-learning architecture mapping input conditions to full trajectory outputs, enabling efficient surrogate modeling for battery electrochemical responses
capabilities.reconstruction: Rebuild the branch MLP over the four battery inputs and the trunk MLP over the 30 s time grid, forming voltage and temperature trajectories with plating margin and capacity heads on the branch

capabilities.adds: Fourier neural operator (neuraloperator 2.0, PyTorch backend only) over the 30 s time grid; inputs broadcast over time map to voltage and temperature trajectories; dense head gives plating margin and capacity
capabilities.attack_surface: Fourier layer weights and spectral modes; an attacker could exploit frequency-domain structure or mode truncation to probe model behavior
capabilities.bounds: lab_kind battery_torch_fno; selector fno; PyTorch backend only
capabilities.rationale: Spectral operator-learning architecture for battery trajectories; captures frequency-domain structure in voltage and temperature evolution
capabilities.reconstruction: Rebuild the FNO with neuraloperator 2.0 on PyTorch, mapping time-broadcast inputs to voltage and temperature trajectories over the 30 s grid, with a dense head for plating margin and capacity

capabilities.adds: Number of neighbours averaged for the kNN model
capabilities.attack_surface: Extreme values (1 neighbour) could overfit to training cases; high values could smooth away important local structure
capabilities.bounds: uint, 1–64, default 5; applies to knn
capabilities.rationale: Controls the bias-variance trade-off of the kNN baseline; more neighbours smooth predictions, fewer preserve local detail
capabilities.reconstruction: Rebuild the kNN neighbour count parameter in the model construction code

capabilities.adds: Hidden width for MLP, DeepONet and FNO models
capabilities.attack_surface: Very wide networks could overfit the small training set; very narrow networks could underfit
capabilities.bounds: uint, 8–512, default 256; applies to mlp, deeponet, fno
capabilities.rationale: Primary capacity control for the neural model families; width scales expressivity and compute cost
capabilities.reconstruction: Rebuild the hidden width parameter in the model construction code for all applicable families

capabilities.adds: Hidden layers (MLP) or Fourier layers (FNO)
capabilities.attack_surface: Deeper networks are harder to optimize and could exhibit training instabilities; an attacker could exploit gradient pathologies
capabilities.bounds: uint, 1–6, default 3; applies to mlp, fno
capabilities.rationale: Controls network depth and compositional expressivity for MLP and FNO families
capabilities.reconstruction: Rebuild the layer count parameter in the model construction code for MLP and FNO

capabilities.adds: Fourier modes kept per layer for the FNO, of the 61 the 121-point grid has
capabilities.attack_surface: Mode truncation creates a frequency-domain blind spot; an attacker could craft inputs with energy in truncated modes
capabilities.bounds: uint, 1–61, default 16; applies to fno
capabilities.rationale: Controls the spectral resolution of the FNO; more modes capture higher-frequency trajectory detail at increased cost
capabilities.reconstruction: Rebuild the Fourier mode count parameter in the FNO construction code

capabilities.adds: Branch and trunk hidden layers for the DeepONet
capabilities.attack_surface: Deeper branch/trunk networks increase the risk of overfitting on the small dataset
capabilities.bounds: uint, 1–6, default 2; applies to deeponet
capabilities.rationale: Controls depth of both branch and trunk subnetworks in the DeepONet architecture
capabilities.reconstruction: Rebuild the branch and trunk depth parameters in the DeepONet construction code

capabilities.adds: Trunk basis functions per trajectory for the DeepONet
capabilities.attack_surface: More basis functions increase capacity and overfitting risk; fewer may miss trajectory structure
capabilities.bounds: uint, 2–64, default 16; applies to deeponet
capabilities.rationale: Controls the rank of the trunk output basis, governing the expressivity of the trajectory representation
capabilities.reconstruction: Rebuild the trunk basis function count in the DeepONet construction code

capabilities.adds: PCA heads per trajectory for the MLP (0 = one output per sample)
capabilities.attack_surface: PCA truncation could miss high-frequency trajectory components; an attacker could exploit the retained subspace
capabilities.bounds: uint, 0–32, default 0; applies to mlp
capabilities.rationale: Allows the MLP to predict trajectories via a low-rank PCA basis instead of full per-timestep outputs
capabilities.reconstruction: Rebuild the PCA head structure in the MLP construction code, with optional dimensionality reduction on trajectory targets

capabilities.adds: Arrhenius, log-rate and interaction input features for MLP, DeepONet and FNO
capabilities.attack_surface: Additional engineered features expand the input dimension; an attacker could exploit feature interactions or extrapolation in engineered space
capabilities.bounds: bool, default false; applies to mlp, deeponet, fno
capabilities.rationale: Augments inputs with physically motivated features (Arrhenius terms, log-rates, interactions) to improve generalization
capabilities.reconstruction: Rebuild the input feature augmentation pipeline with Arrhenius, log-rate and interaction features

capabilities.adds: Hidden-layer activation function for MLP and DeepONet
capabilities.attack_surface: Different activations have different saturation and gradient properties; an attacker could exploit activation-specific dead zones or saturation
capabilities.bounds: choice: gelu, relu, tanh, silu, softplus; default gelu; applies to mlp, deeponet
capabilities.rationale: Activation choice affects optimization landscape and model expressivity; GELU is the campaign default
capabilities.reconstruction: Rebuild the activation function selection in the model construction code for MLP and DeepONet

capabilities.adds: Normalization after each hidden layer for MLP and DeepONet
capabilities.attack_surface: Normalization changes the loss landscape; an attacker could exploit normalization-induced scale invariances
capabilities.bounds: choice: none, layer_norm; default none; applies to mlp, deeponet
capabilities.rationale: Optional layer normalization stabilizes training of deeper networks; off by default per the campaign recipe
capabilities.reconstruction: Rebuild the optional layer normalization in the model construction code for MLP and DeepONet

capabilities.adds: Weight initialization scheme for MLP and DeepONet
capabilities.attack_surface: Different initializations reach different basins; an attacker could exploit initialization-dependent failure modes
capabilities.bounds: choice: he_normal, glorot_normal, lecun_normal; default he_normal; applies to mlp, deeponet
capabilities.rationale: Initialization affects optimization trajectory and final model quality; He normal is the default for ReLU-like activations
capabilities.reconstruction: Rebuild the weight initialization scheme in the model construction code for MLP and DeepONet

capabilities.adds: Voltage head that cannot exceed the 4.2 V cycler limit (off: raw control)
capabilities.attack_surface: The bound prevents over-voltage predictions but could mask model errors near the boundary; an attacker could exploit the clipping behavior
capabilities.bounds: bool, default true; applies to mlp, deeponet, fno
capabilities.rationale: Enforces the physical voltage ceiling of the battery cycler, preventing physically implausible predictions above 4.2 V
capabilities.reconstruction: Rebuild the bounded voltage head that clips or constrains predictions to the 4.2 V cycler limit

capabilities.adds: V(0) from the published OCV table (off: predicted)
capabilities.attack_surface: Hard-coding V(0) from the OCV table removes a degree of freedom; an attacker could exploit the fixed initial condition
capabilities.bounds: bool, default true; applies to mlp, deeponet, fno
capabilities.rationale: Sets the initial voltage from the known open-circuit voltage table rather than predicting it, enforcing the physical initial condition
capabilities.reconstruction: Rebuild the OCV-based initial voltage assignment from the published table, overriding the predicted V(0)

capabilities.adds: Capacity as cycle-1 capacity plus fade (off: each checkpoint directly)
capabilities.attack_surface: The decomposition constrains capacity predictions; an attacker could exploit the fade term to probe degradation modeling
capabilities.bounds: bool, default true; applies to mlp, deeponet, fno
capabilities.rationale: Decomposes capacity prediction into a known cycle-1 baseline plus a learned fade term, enforcing monotonic degradation structure
capabilities.reconstruction: Rebuild the capacity fade head that predicts capacity as cycle-1 capacity plus a learned fade term

capabilities.adds: Number of training updates
capabilities.attack_surface: Very high step counts could overfit; very low counts could underfit; an attacker could exploit training duration to probe convergence behavior
capabilities.bounds: uint, 16–20000, default 6000; applies to mlp, deeponet, fno
capabilities.rationale: Controls training duration; more steps allow better convergence but risk overfitting the small dataset
capabilities.reconstruction: Rebuild the training step count parameter in the training loop

capabilities.adds: Cases per update (at or above the TRAIN cases: full batch)
capabilities.attack_surface: Small batch sizes introduce gradient noise that could be exploited; large batches reduce noise but may converge to sharp minima
capabilities.bounds: uint, 8–400, default 400; applies to mlp, deeponet, fno
capabilities.rationale: Controls gradient noise; full-batch (400) is the campaign default for the small dataset
capabilities.reconstruction: Rebuild the batch size parameter in the training loop

capabilities.adds: Gradient accumulation within a batch
capabilities.attack_surface: Gradient accumulation introduces numerical differences from true full-batch; an attacker could exploit accumulation artifacts
capabilities.bounds: uint, 1–8, default 1; applies to mlp, deeponet, fno
capabilities.rationale: Allows simulating large batches on memory-constrained hardware via gradient accumulation
capabilities.reconstruction: Rebuild the microbatch gradient accumulation logic in the training loop

capabilities.adds: Optimizer family (adam: campaign's written-out Adam(W); others: optax)
capabilities.attack_surface: Different optimizers have different convergence basins; an attacker could exploit optimizer-specific failure modes or adaptive rate artifacts
capabilities.bounds: choice: adam, lion, lamb, adafactor, radam, nadamw, sgd_momentum, muon, prodigy, free_adamw, sam; default adam; applies to mlp, deeponet, fno
capabilities.rationale: Allows selecting from a family of optimizers; Adam(W) is the campaign default, others are available via optax
capabilities.reconstruction: Rebuild the optimizer selection logic, with the campaign's written-out Adam(W) and optax implementations for other choices

capabilities.adds: Peak learning rate
capabilities.attack_surface: Extreme learning rates could produce unstable or degenerate models; an attacker could probe rate-dependent failure modes
capabilities.bounds: float, 1e-05–0.05, default 0.002; applies to mlp, deeponet, fno
capabilities.rationale: Primary optimization step size control; too high diverges, too low underfits within the step budget
capabilities.reconstruction: Rebuild the peak learning rate parameter in the optimizer configuration

capabilities.adds: Decoupled weight decay
capabilities.attack_surface: High decay could over-regularize and mask model capacity; an attacker could exploit regularization-induced bias
capabilities.bounds: float, 0.0–0.1, default 0.0; applies to mlp, deeponet, fno
capabilities.rationale: L2 regularization via decoupled decay; off by default per the campaign recipe
capabilities.reconstruction: Rebuild the decoupled weight decay parameter in the optimizer configuration

capabilities.adds: Decay every parameter, or weight matrices only
capabilities.attack_surface: Decay mask changes which parameters are regularized; an attacker could exploit unregularized parameters
capabilities.bounds: choice: all, matrices; default all; applies to mlp, deeponet, fno
capabilities.rationale: Controls whether bias and normalization parameters are decayed; matrices-only is a common best practice
capabilities.reconstruction: Rebuild the weight decay mask logic in the optimizer configuration

capabilities.adds: Global-norm gradient clipping (0: none)
capabilities.attack_surface: Clipping could mask gradient pathology; an attacker could exploit clipping-induced scale invariance
capabilities.bounds: float, 0.0–100.0, default 0.0; applies to mlp, deeponet, fno
capabilities.rationale: Prevents gradient explosions; off by default per the campaign recipe
capabilities.reconstruction: Rebuild the global-norm gradient clipping in the training loop

capabilities.adds: Beta1 (first moment decay) for Adam-family optimizers
capabilities.attack_surface: Extreme beta1 values change the momentum behavior; an attacker could exploit momentum-induced oscillations or lag
capabilities.bounds: float, 0.0–0.9999, default 0.9; applies to mlp, deeponet, fno
capabilities.rationale: Controls the exponential decay rate for the first moment estimate in Adam-family optimizers
capabilities.reconstruction: Rebuild the beta1 parameter in the optimizer configuration

capabilities.adds: Beta2 (second moment decay) for Adam-family optimizers
capabilities.attack_surface: Extreme beta2 values change the adaptive rate behavior; an attacker could exploit adaptive rate artifacts
capabilities.bounds: float, 0.0–0.99999, default 0.999; applies to mlp, deeponet, fno
capabilities.rationale: Controls the exponential decay rate for the second moment estimate in Adam-family optimizers
capabilities.reconstruction: Rebuild the beta2 parameter in the optimizer configuration

capabilities.adds: Adam-family epsilon for numerical stability
capabilities.attack_surface: Large epsilon could dampen adaptive rates; an attacker could exploit epsilon-induced scale changes
capabilities.bounds: float, 1e-12–0.01, default 1e-08; applies to mlp, deeponet, fno
capabilities.rationale: Prevents division by zero in Adam's second moment normalization
capabilities.reconstruction: Rebuild the epsilon parameter in the optimizer configuration

capabilities.adds: Learning-rate curve over the updates
capabilities.attack_surface: Different schedules reach different minima; an attacker could exploit schedule-dependent convergence behavior
capabilities.bounds: choice: cosine, constant, piecewise, exponential, one_cycle, sgdr, polynomial, train_loss_plateau; default cosine; applies to mlp, deeponet, fno
capabilities.rationale: Controls the learning rate schedule shape; cosine decay is the campaign default
capabilities.reconstruction: Rebuild the learning rate schedule logic with all supported curve types

capabilities.adds: Linear warmup steps before the main schedule
capabilities.attack_surface: Warmup changes early training dynamics; an attacker could exploit warmup-induced sensitivity to initialization
capabilities.bounds: uint, 0–20000, default 0; applies to mlp, deeponet, fno
capabilities.rationale: Gradually increases the learning rate at the start of training to stabilize early optimization; off by default
capabilities.reconstruction: Rebuild the linear warmup logic in the learning rate schedule

capabilities.adds: Final learning rate as a fraction of the peak (cosine, exponential, polynomial)
capabilities.attack_surface: Non-zero floor keeps training active late; an attacker could exploit late-training noise
capabilities.bounds: float, 0.0–1.0, default 0.0; applies to mlp, deeponet, fno
capabilities.rationale: Controls the floor of decay schedules; 0.0 means the rate decays to zero
capabilities.reconstruction: Rebuild the minimum learning rate ratio in the schedule logic

capabilities.adds: Divide each case's error by its target energy
capabilities.attack_surface: Relative weighting changes which cases dominate the loss; an attacker could exploit normalization-induced reweighting
capabilities.bounds: bool, default false; applies to mlp, deeponet, fno
capabilities.rationale: Normalizes the loss by target magnitude, giving equal weight to high and low energy cases; off by default
capabilities.reconstruction: Rebuild the relative loss normalization in the objective function

capabilities.adds: Extra trajectory error weighted toward early or late times
capabilities.attack_surface: Non-uniform weighting shifts accuracy across the trajectory; an attacker could exploit underweighted regions
capabilities.bounds: choice: uniform, early, late; default uniform; applies to mlp, deeponet, fno
capabilities.rationale: Allows emphasizing errors at specific trajectory phases; uniform is the default
capabilities.reconstruction: Rebuild the time-weighting logic in the trajectory loss function

capabilities.adds: First time-derivative error of the trajectories
capabilities.attack_surface: Derivative penalties change the smoothness bias; an attacker could exploit smoothness constraints to hide errors in the value loss
capabilities.bounds: float, 0.0–10.0, default 0.0; applies to mlp, deeponet, fno
capabilities.rationale: Penalizes errors in the rate of change of trajectories, encouraging smoother predictions; off by default
capabilities.reconstruction: Rebuild the first-derivative penalty term in the objective function

capabilities.adds: Second time-derivative error of the trajectories
capabilities.attack_surface: Second-derivative penalties constrain trajectory curvature; an attacker could exploit curvature constraints
capabilities.bounds: float, 0.0–10.0, default 0.0; applies to mlp, deeponet, fno
capabilities.rationale: Penalizes errors in the curvature of trajectories, encouraging physically plausible dynamics; off by default
capabilities.reconstruction: Rebuild the second-derivative penalty term in the objective function

capabilities.adds: Frequency-weighted trajectory error (higher frequencies weigh more)
capabilities.attack_surface: Spectral weighting shifts accuracy across frequencies; an attacker could exploit underweighted frequency bands
capabilities.bounds: float, 0.0–10.0, default 0.0; applies to mlp, deeponet, fno
capabilities.rationale: Emphasizes high-frequency trajectory components in the loss, improving capture of fast dynamics; off by default
capabilities.reconstruction: Rebuild the spectral weighting logic in the trajectory loss function

capabilities.adds: Final L-BFGS steps, taken from the step budget
capabilities.attack_surface: L-BFGS could find sharp minima that generalize poorly; an attacker could exploit second-order convergence artifacts
capabilities.bounds: uint, 0–2000, default 0; applies to mlp, deeponet, fno
capabilities.rationale: Allows a quasi-Newton polishing phase after the main optimizer; off by default
capabilities.reconstruction: Rebuild the L-BFGS polishing stage in the training loop, drawing steps from the main budget

capabilities.adds: Ensemble members sharing the step budget equally
capabilities.attack_surface: Ensemble averaging changes the prediction distribution; an attacker could exploit member diversity or correlation
capabilities.bounds: uint, 1–4, default 1; applies to mlp, deeponet, fno
capabilities.rationale: Trains multiple models with the shared step budget and averages predictions; single member is the default
capabilities.reconstruction: Rebuild the ensemble training and averaging logic in the inference pipeline

capabilities.adds: Average parameters over this final fraction of the updates
capabilities.attack_surface: Weight averaging changes the final model; an attacker could exploit averaging-induced smoothing
capabilities.bounds: float, 0.0–0.9, default 0.0; applies to mlp, deeponet, fno
capabilities.rationale: Weight averaging over the tail of training can improve generalization; off by default
capabilities.reconstruction: Rebuild the tail-averaging logic in the training loop, maintaining a running average of parameters

capabilities.adds: Predict from params or EMA
capabilities.attack_surface: EMA weights have different properties than raw params; an attacker could exploit EMA-specific artifacts
capabilities.bounds: choice: params, ema; default params; applies to mlp, deeponet, fno
capabilities.rationale: Allows using exponential moving average weights for prediction; params is the default
capabilities.reconstruction: Rebuild the inference weight selection logic, supporting both raw params and EMA weights

capabilities.adds: EMA decay (with EMA inference)
capabilities.attack_surface: EMA decay changes the effective averaging window; an attacker could exploit decay-dependent lag
capabilities.bounds: float, 0.0–0.99999, default 0.99; applies to mlp, deeponet, fno
capabilities.rationale: Controls the exponential moving average decay rate for the EMA weights
capabilities.reconstruction: Rebuild the EMA computation logic in the training loop

capabilities.adds: Training and prediction precision
capabilities.attack_surface: Precision changes numerical behavior; an attacker could exploit float32 rounding or float64 memory costs
capabilities.bounds: choice: float32, float64; default float32; applies to mlp, deeponet, fno
capabilities.rationale: Allows double precision for numerical stability; float32 is the default
capabilities.reconstruction: Rebuild the precision configuration in the training and inference code

capabilities.adds: Reconstruction backend: Carbon rebuilds the recipe with its own trainer in this framework's pinned worker image (OWNER-PYTORCH-BACKEND-01)
capabilities.attack_surface: Backend differences could lead to numerical discrepancies; an attacker could exploit framework-specific behavior
capabilities.bounds: choice: jax, pytorch; default jax; applies to mlp, deeponet, fno
capabilities.rationale: Allows PyTorch as an alternative backend for reconstruction; JAX is the default, PyTorch uses the pinned worker image
capabilities.reconstruction: Rebuild the recipe in both JAX and PyTorch, with the PyTorch backend using the OWNER-PYTORCH-BACKEND-01 pinned worker image

capabilities.adds: Seeded subset of TRAIN v1; resolution and new cases stay fixed
capabilities.attack_surface: Subsetting changes which cases the model sees; an attacker could exploit subset selection to probe training distribution
capabilities.bounds: float, 0.1–1.0, default 1.0; applies to all
capabilities.rationale: Allows training on a subset of the training data; full set is the default
capabilities.reconstruction: Rebuild the seeded training data subset selection logic

capabilities.adds: Weight of TRAIN cases in the published important region
capabilities.attack_surface: Region weighting shifts the effective training distribution; an attacker could exploit underweighted regions
capabilities.bounds: float, 0.0–10.0, default 1.0; applies to mlp, deeponet, fno
capabilities.rationale: Up- or down-weights cases in the published important operating region; default 1.0 is uniform
capabilities.reconstruction: Rebuild the important-region case weighting logic in the data pipeline

capabilities.adds: Admit TRAIN cases by charge rate over the first half of training
capabilities.attack_surface: Curriculum changes the order of case presentation; an attacker could exploit curriculum-induced training dynamics
capabilities.bounds: choice: none, low_rate_first, high_rate_first; default none; applies to mlp, deeponet, fno
capabilities.rationale: Curriculum learning by charge rate; none is the default
capabilities.reconstruction: Rebuild the curriculum admission logic in the data pipeline

capabilities.adds: Up-weight cases with high current TRAIN loss (exponent)
capabilities.attack_surface: Hard example weighting focuses on difficult cases; an attacker could exploit the reweighting to probe outlier sensitivity
capabilities.bounds: float, 0.0–4.0, default 0.0; applies to mlp, deeponet, fno
capabilities.rationale: Hard example mining via loss-based reweighting; off by default
capabilities.reconstruction: Rebuild the hard-example weighting logic in the data pipeline

left_out: hybrid.composition_graphs: excluded — participant-defined composition graphs (trigger: executable_submission)
hybrid.reference_solver_reuse: excluded — hybrids reusing the PyBaMM reference; validation is JAX-only (trigger: evidence_design_change)
inference.final_label_selection: excluded — checkpoint selection by final labels (trigger: evidence_design_change)
model_family.julia_backend: excluded — Julia families (NeuralOperators.jl, NeuralPDE); validator reconstruction is JAX or PyTorch (trigger: authority_boundary_widening)
model_family.pretrained_weights: excluded — pretrained weights, checkpoints or embeddings (trigger: external_data_or_learned_state)
objective.loss_expressions: excluded — losses supplied as code or expressions (trigger: executable_submission)
training_data.label_method: excluded — per-submission reference labels; the reference is PyBaMM and validation is JAX-only (trigger: evidence_design_change)
training_data.submitted_datasets: excluded — uploaded datasets or miner-chosen seeds (trigger: external_data_or_learned_state)
Level 3 has nothing in today's contract

decision.ref: Asked "Accept Graphite's six battery level proposals?", the technical owner chose "Accept all six (Recommended)" (level-plan-3, GRAPHITE-GRANT-PLANNER-02)
